scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact comparison of every term in Wang's finite stratum maximum. It uses the printed formula for Proposition 3.17, positivity of the weights, and the proposition's established global hyperbolicity implication. No finite search, numerical experiment, or unproved classification is used.
limitations: The criterion is sufficient rather than necessary; optimality for each weight vector is not claimed.
The argument applies to Wang's well-formed weighted projective spaces with isolated singularities and does not extend the theorem to non-isolated singularities.
The conclusion concerns very general hypersurfaces in the specified linear systems.

title: Wang's stratum maximum is always attained by the ambient weighted projective space
